clientFunction.name: get_overview
clientFunction.description: Return the customer's spending headline for a given calendar month: total spend, the single biggest category, and (for the current month only) the flagged anomaly transaction if one exists. Call this as the natural first step on any spending question — it gives you the totals you need plus the anomaly hook for the warm 'I noticed Netflix renewed yesterday' narrative. Returns { month_label, total, top_category:{name,total}, anomaly?:{vendor,amount,renewal_days_ago} }. Pass show=true when the customer asked to SEE their spending ("show me my spending", "open spending"): the app navigates to the spending page and surfaces the overview view in addition to returning the data — no separate navigate_to call needed.

month.description: Optional. 0 = current month (default), 1 = last month, 2 = two months ago. Values outside 0..2 return { error: 'no_data_for_month' }.

show.description: Optional. When true, the app also navigates to the spending page and surfaces the overview view. Use when the customer asked to SEE/OPEN spending; omit (or false) for pure data lookups.
